claim: fictional policy fixture; values demonstrate mechanics and are not production recommendations

invariants.statement: A work unit SHALL NOT enter IN_PROGRESS until mandatory dependencies satisfy their required predecessor state.
Concurrently executing work units SHALL NOT hold conflicting exclusive write ownership.
An agent SHALL NOT receive permissions outside its active work-unit authority.
A shared-contract revision change SHALL invalidate affected downstream execution contexts.
A VERIFIED work unit SHALL return to REVALIDATION_REQUIRED when its implementation revision changes.
A child agent SHALL NOT receive authority exceeding the delegated authority of its parent execution.
At most one active execution lease SHALL exist for an exclusive work-unit assignment.
A work unit SHALL NOT become VERIFIED without evidence bound to current implementation and specification revisions.
Integration evidence SHALL identify the exact component revisions it evaluates.
A downstream work unit SHALL consume only contract revisions in its execution context or approved refresh.

control_plane_boundary: The orchestrator schedules approved work and enforces workflow rules; it cannot approve policy, architecture, requirements, merge, or release.
